meta.scope: offline static; no firmware written, no flash touched, no radio contacted
meta.method: independent BCL LZ77 decoder; fail-closed parse of every SGMT occurrence; sentinel, overlap, length, trailing-byte and RAM-offset checks; receipt-to-byte correspondence for the three PB-040 roles
meta.reader_note: tools/qca988x/sgmt_container_inspector.py and firmware/xtensa_sgmt_surgical_patcher.py were read for the format only and were not edited or imported
premise_corrections: the field at offset 4 has two names: the inspector calls it version and requires 1, the patcher calls it file_flags and writes 1 for compressed, so version equals 1 and file_flags equals 1 are the same assertion
the corpus contains only compressed containers, so the file_flags 0 branch A09 asks about is never exercised by any artefact here

gaps: this audit proves container integrity, not that the target loader accepts the file: a self-consistent roundtrip is not equivalence with the device decoder
the corpus has no uncompressed container, so the file_flags 0 branch remains untested
container validity says nothing about whether the patched site is executed, which is the central A09 objection
no dmesg, no debugfs and no post-reload evidence was read by this stage
